fact: A January 2025 Parliament committee report records that UCC collects a 2% levy on operators' gross annual revenue under the Uganda Communications Act, 50% of it remitted to the Consolidated Fund, and recommends the Ministry of Finance reimburse the levy for ICT development and rural communications through UCUSAF.
title: Report of the Committee on Information, Communications Technology and National Guidance on the Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund
publisher: Parliament of the Republic of Uganda
